changelog: Fix: TradeController::saveTrade()'s INSERT branch (add_trade) has thrown PDOException SQLSTATE[HY093] on every new-trade save since v3.14.0 -- the trailing placeholder count ($ph) was left at count($cols)+4 when v3.14.0 dropped pnl/net_pnl/r_multiple from the appended columns, leaving 2 unbound '?' tokens in the VALUES clause against 19 real bound values. Corrected to count($cols)+2, matching the 2 columns (screenshot, screenshots) actually appended beyond $cols. The update_trade path was checked too and was already correct -- this was INSERT-only

Add: add_trade/update_trade are now wrapped in try/catch -- any exception from here on (the DB writes, trade_variables, trade_journal, the v3.16.1 risk-field computation) returns HTTP 500 with {"success":false,"error":"<message>"} instead of an uncaught PDOException producing an empty response body, which the frontend was surfacing as 'Unexpected end of JSON input'

Verify: pre-tag, built the exact bound-params arrays saveTrade()/persistTradeRiskFields() produce for an Open trade (stop+target set, no entry_price/lot_size -- this form has never collected those, since v3.14.0) and for editing an existing closed imported trade (all seven v3.16.1 risk fields real), and asserted placeholder count === bound param count for every statement in both cases. Confirmed computeTradeRiskFields() already keeps all seven keys present with null values rather than omitting them when entry_price/lot_size are null -- no change needed there, just verified
